verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent can analyze requirements and create new tasks in Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com (codegen-docs-3, codegen-docs-28, codegen-docs-1). It can also present structured step-by-step plans (codegen-docs-22). So a PM could prompt it to turn feedback into tracker tasks. Nothing in the evidence shows it taking in user feedback submissions or producing scoped specs, and the plans are for implementation rather than product scope. Missing for 10: ingestion of user feedback submissions, structured task templates with proposed scope or acceptance criteria, any hands-on or independent corroboration of a feedback-to-task workflow.
